'''Red Squadron''', also known as '''Red Wing''' or '''Red Group''', was the designation of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] active across [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], participating in the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Organization==
===The Old Republic===
{{Main|Red Wing (Old Republic)}}
[[File:AurekFighter.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Red Wing ''Aurek''-class fighter at the Battle of Rakata Prime.]]
The [[Jedi Civil War]]-era<ref name="KotOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[Red Wing (Old Republic)|Red Squadron]] was assigned to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Forn Dodonna]], and was equipped with [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighters]] and [[S-250 Chela-class starfighter|S-250 ''Chela''-class starfighters]].<ref name="KotOR" />

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Red Wing participated in the [[Battle of Telos IV]] at the command of Admiral [[Carth Onasi]], alongside [[Blue Wing (squadron)|Blue Wing]], where it fought against the [[Sith Triumvirate|Sith]] forces of [[Darth Nihilus]].<ref name="KotOR2" />

===Rise of the Empire===
During the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] and early [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], prior to the development of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]-oriented [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], Red Squadron consisted entirely of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], flying [[A-6 Interceptor]]s and later, [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]].<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="Rep50" /> Following the clones' integration into the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], command was held alternatively by a Jedi, such as [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]],<ref name="Rep61" /> or a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]].<ref name="HasbroGoji" />

As clones began to fill the ranks of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter starfighters]] (developed just prior to the outbreak of the war) were assigned to Red Squadron's clone pilots.

Red Squadron was also outfitted with a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] bearing [[Color/Legends|red]] markings, augmenting the V-19s that they fielded.<ref name="SWPMTCG:CWT">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars Tactics|cardname=Red Squadron V-19 Torrent}}</ref>

After the development of the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]], Red Squadron was among the units in the Republic fleet to receive ARC-170s for combat. Red Squadron piloting these new ships preferred their craft to be balanced more in favor of shields than firepower when compared to their comrades in [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], making them valuable for penetration runs.

==History==
===Before the Clone Wars===
At the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]], the climactic battle of the Jedi Civil War,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Red Squadron fought with Admiral Forn Dodonna's fleet. During the confrontation, the squadron reinforced the breach in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] battle lines created by [[Green Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Green Squadron]], further paving the way for Dodonna's [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|capital ships]] to assault the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] the [[Star Forge]].<ref name="KotOR" /> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Admiral [[Carth Onasi]] directed Red Wing to engage the starfighter forces of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] in [[Battle of Telos IV|defense]] of [[Citadel Station]].<ref name="KotOR2" />

The Jedi-piloted A-6 Interceptors<ref name="TEGTW" /> of Red Squadron saw action during the Stark Hyperspace War in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], launching with other Republic-aligned squadrons from [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Captor-class heavy munitions cruiser|freighters]] into battle against the [[Stark Commercial Combine]] at the [[Fifth Battle of Qotile]]. Along with [[Blue Squadron (Jedi Order)|Blue Squadron]], Red Squadron was led by the ace pilot, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Saesee Tiin.<ref name="SW39" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Red Squadron, engage transports from orbit.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]]|<ref name="Rep50" />}}
[[File:BattleofKaminospace.jpg|thumb|right|129px|Red Squadron's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]].]]

Early in the Clone Wars, Red Squadron's Jedi adopted Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors, and were commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], with his support, [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who led their flight against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] at the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]], while Blue Squadron Leader General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] group targeted enemy [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|transports]].<ref name="Rep50" />

Later in the war, Red Squadron was under the command of Jedi Master Plo Koon. With fellow Jedi [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] Blue Squadron, Koon led his V-19 Torrent squadron from a Delta-7 interceptor, defending a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|diplomatic cruiser]] carrying [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] from [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attack ships.<ref name="Rep61" />

During the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], a Red Squadron Y-wing [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] that was equipped with a prototype weapon known as an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]]. Piloted by squadron leader<ref name="HasbroGoji" /> [[Goji/Legends|Goji]] and [[Gunner/Legends|clone gunner]] [[Rod/Legends|Rod]], it flew in formation with Y-wings against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Goji successfully released the bomb on target which created a massive [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]], deactivating or destroying all the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces gathered on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="TZB" />

Flying the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Star Runner]]'' with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Jedi Master [[Mavra Zane]] led a Red Squadron, also called Red Group, of Delta-7 interceptor pilots&mdash;including two of her own [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentices&mdash;in [[Rebellion on Felucia|pursuit]] of Separatist leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] over [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. Destroying a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] and clearing a path for [[Grand Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] fleet, Red Squadron followed Mai's [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|dreadnaught]], [[Subjugator (Subjugator-class)|''Subjugator'']], to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she plotted to [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|attack]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] with the biological weapon [[Trihexalon]]. Cutting through ''Subjugator''{{'s}} screen of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]], and losing "[[Red Four/Legends|Red Four]]" to an enemy [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|heavy fighter]], the squadron kept [[Turret/Legends|turret]] fire off of the Delta-7s of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Group]] as they disabled the captial ship's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]], allowing Red Squadron to enter the Trihexalon deployment system in an attack run on the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], destroying the ''Subjugator'' and foiling the plot.<ref name="Kinect" />

===The Destruction of Red Squadron===
During the [[recapture of Tythe]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi led Red Squadron through the Separatist fleet on a mission to capture [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] alive. Initially managing to destroy a [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Battlecruiser|battle cruiser]] on the way, the squadron, nonetheless, was destroyed by defending [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|hailfire droids]], [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]], and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] once they reached the lower atmosphere of [[Tythe]].

==Behind the scenes==
While Adi Gallia's entry in [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Databank (original)|Databank]] refers to her as the leader of Red Squadron during Bail Organa's rescue from pirates,<ref name="AGDB">{{DB|character|adigallia|Gallia, Adi}}</ref> the comic issue [[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]], the original source, portrays Plo Koon as Red Squadron's leader, with Gallia commanding Blue Squadron.<ref name="Rep61" />
